threat_event: Payment-instruction fraud succeeds in one or more divisions (fraudulent loan funding wire, vendor-impersonation remittance change, or business account takeover)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CRE Lending funds on emailed instructions with callbacks to numbers in the closing package; client tenants without business MFA; support staff not trained on vendor impersonation
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-B2 wires; SYS-S1 business payments; SYS-R1 funding; SYS-G4 email
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.a; III.C.2); N52-R02 (12 CFR 225 App. F III.C)
existing_controls: Bank callback standard with independently verified numbers; dual control on every wire; bank payment-fraud training; payment fraud model
treatment_plan: One group callback standard for all divisions; CRE funding moved to the bank's verified-instruction service; business payment MFA mandatory in all tenants; vendor-impersonation training for client-facing staff

threat_event: Stolen workforce session tokens let an attacker move through shared identity and email into several divisions' systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12-hour single sign-on sessions not bound to devices; token replay not correlated with email and console activity; service account static keys
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.a; III.C.1.f)
existing_controls: Number-matching MFA; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; 24x7 SOC; email security gateway
treatment_plan: Device-bound sessions of 8 hours or less; step-up for sensitive console actions; token-replay detection across email and consoles; workload identity for service accounts

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulator, client, customer, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank matrix does not cover the other divisions; 61 client banks without a designated notice contact; no cross-division exercise
existing_controls: Bank incident plan with 36-hour determination step; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Adopt the multi-regulator matrix (P08); collect designated contacts; cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: The digital banking platform is compromised or down for hours, hitting the bank and 310 client institutions at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration: one multi-tenant platform for about 19 million end users; support console reads every tenant; gateway single point of failure
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.a; III.C.1.h); 12 CFR 53.3; 53.4
existing_controls: Tenant isolation by schema and key; WAF and DDoS protection; warm standby region; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: Tenant-scoped support access; hot gateway standby; region failover test; tenant isolation tests each release

threat_event: AI used in credit decisions (the bank's model and the data service sold to 64 client banks) produces unexplained or unfair outcomes
threat_source: AI model error and governance gaps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reason codes do not match cash-flow drivers; no developer documentation or fairness testing for the data service; AI standard adopted after deployment
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-B3 credit model; SYS-S2 data service
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1); N51-R01 (FTC Act Sec. 5); ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.9)
existing_controls: Model risk management validation for the bank model; underwriters decide; Group AI Standard (2026)
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program conditions (P10): reason code remap, fairness testing, developer documentation, change gate

threat_event: Ransomware halts core and payments in the group data centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity and network connect all divisions to the data centers; legacy branch workstations
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.h); 12 CFR 53.3; N52-R08 (Form 8-K Item 1.05)
existing_controls: EDR everywhere; PAM; immutable backups in provider B; semiannual core failover test
treatment_plan: Isolated recovery environment for core; quarterly restore tests of core to the isolated environment

threat_event: A critical third party fails (card processor, cloud provider A, core software vendor, loan origination SaaS)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Concentration on a few providers; exit plans untested
existing_controls: Annual SOC report reviews for outside vendors; contracts with notice terms
treatment_plan: Exit and substitution plans for the four critical vendors; annual tabletop with the card processor

threat_event: Division controls drift from group policy and cannot be shown to inherit common controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commercial Real Estate still uses the acquired company's 2023 policies; inheritance undocumented
existing_controls: Group policies v2026; annual attestation for bank and Financial Software
treatment_plan: Re-issue the Commercial Real Estate supplement; inheritance matrix; include the division in the 2027 assessment cycle
owner: Commercial Real Estate security and compliance lead

threat_event: Affiliate service providers are overseen less closely than outside vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The bank has not reviewed the Financial Software SOC reports or mapped its CUECs; the 2021 intercompany agreement lacks notice and audit terms; CRE Lending services loans for the bank under an informal agreement
affected_asset_or_process: CDBP (bank tenant); CRE servicing for the bank
existing_controls: Intercompany agreements; group third-party policy
treatment_plan: Treat affiliates as critical vendors: annual SOC review, CUEC mapping, amended intercompany agreements
owner: Head of Technology and Cyber Risk

threat_event: A privileged or support insider misuses access across tenants or divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing support console access to all tenants; large support team
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.a; III.C.1.e)
existing_controls: PAM for administrators; background checks; quarterly certification
treatment_plan: Ticket-linked, tenant-scoped support access; support console activity review

threat_event: Distributed denial of service against digital banking
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing platform for 311 tenants
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF; rate limits
treatment_plan: Annual DDoS test with the provider; client communication templates

threat_event: Physical intrusion at a data center or operations center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many buildings; one alarm monitoring vendor
existing_controls: Badge plus biometric entry, mantraps, guards, video
treatment_plan: Keep; annual physical penetration test of both data centers

threat_event: Malicious code enters the platform through the build pipeline or a dependency
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many open-source dependencies; source hosting SaaS
existing_controls: Protected branches; signed builds; dependency scanning
treatment_plan: Build provenance attestation; dependency allow-list for payment code paths

threat_event: The payment fraud model misses a new fraud pattern
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model retrained quarterly; fraud patterns shift faster
existing_controls: Fraud operations review; model monitoring
treatment_plan: Monthly challenger model; fraud loss feedback loop
owner: Bank contact center and fraud director

threat_event: The disclosure committee delays or mis-states a materiality determination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cross-division incidents are hard to size quickly; qualitative factors (client institution trust) are new
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter covers cybersecurity; outside counsel
treatment_plan: Materiality factor worksheet in P08; exercise in the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: Cyber risk data cannot be aggregated quickly for the boards and supervisors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three registers and manual consolidation
existing_controls: Quarterly risk appetite report
treatment_plan: Single register tool with division views

threat_event: Loss of key cyber and platform staff
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Specialist knowledge concentrated in a few engineers
existing_controls: Succession plans for executives
treatment_plan: Succession plans one level down; runbooks for key platform functions

threat_event: A provider A regional outage takes down the platform and credit decisioning
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warm standby region failover last tested 2025-03
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.h); 12 CFR 53.4
existing_controls: Warm standby region; continuous replication
treatment_plan: Region failover test twice a year

threat_event: Personal information of guarantors and client customers spreads into mailboxes and file shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Closing packages and conversion files exchanged by email; no retention enforcement
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 225 App. F III.C); state breach laws (generic)
existing_controls: Group retention schedule; email encryption
treatment_plan: Secure document exchange for closings and conversions; mailbox retention labels

threat_event: Regulatory changes are not tracked consistently across divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Divisions track their own regulators
regulatory_driver: N52-R02; N51-R01; ECOA and Regulation B
existing_controls: Bank regulatory change management
treatment_plan: One regulatory change register covering all three divisions
